# ProjectBase — Full Autonomous Agent Specification & Operating Manual

## 1. System Overview
ProjectBase is the central project management, Kanban, and sprint execution engine on Homelab.
It provides zero-latency SQLite database backing, instant REST APIs, real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE), and direct FastMCP integration for AI agents (Cursor, Flomaster, Hermes, Claude, and Windmill).

## 2. Server Architecture
- Base URL: ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}
- PocketBase Admin UI: ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/_/ (set via ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD)
- OpenAPI Specification: ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/openapi.json
- Interactive Scalar Docs: ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/docs/
- FastMCP Script: /data/projects/projectbase/scripts/mcp_server.py

## 3. Autonomous Agent Operating Loop
When an agent is assigned to work on a project:
1. **Discover Tasks**: Call 'list_issues(project="KEY", status="todo")' or GET /api/collections/issues/records?filter=(project='<PID>' && status='todo').
2. **Claim Task**: Update status to 'in_progress' (update_issue(identifier="KEY-1", status="in_progress")).
3. **Execute Implementation**: Implement code in repository, execute unit tests, run verification.
4. **Log Progress Comments**: Post intermediate observations via 'add_comment(identifier="KEY-1", content="Verified step 1")'.
5. **Mark Done**: Update status to 'done' (update_issue(identifier="KEY-1", status="done")). This fires real-time SSE updates to all open web boards.

## 4. Collections Schema
### projects
- id (15 char text)
- name (text, required)
- identifier (text, uppercase 2-6 chars, e.g. LOAD, IBR, PB, HOME, OMNI, MEM)
- description (text)
- icon (emoji text)
- color (hex color)
- repo_url (text)
- is_favorite (bool)

### issues
- id (15 char text)
- project (relation -> projects, required)
- identifier (text, e.g. LOAD-1, auto-generated by hook)
- issue_number (number, auto-incremented per project)
- title (text, required)
- description (text, markdown)
- status (enum: backlog | todo | in_progress | in_review | done | cancelled)
- priority (enum: urgent | high | medium | low | none)
- estimate (number, story points)
- assignee (text)
- due_date (date)
- cycle (relation -> cycles)
- subtasks (json array of {id, title, done})
- labels (json array of string tags)
- order (number timestamp for drag-and-drop sort)
- custom_fields (json object keyed by project custom-field key, e.g. {"client":"Acme","gate":"P1"})
- relations (json array of {issue, type} edges: blocks | blocked_by | related; reciprocal edges auto-mirrored via /api/projectbase/issues/<ID>/relations)

### cycles (sprints)
- id (15 char text)
- project (relation -> projects, required)
- name (text, e.g. "Sprint 1 - Launch")
- description (text)
- start_date (date)
- end_date (date)
- status (enum: upcoming | active | completed)

### comments
- id (15 char text)
- issue (relation -> issues, required)
- author (text, e.g. "Flomaster Agent", "Andrian")
- author_type (enum: user | agent | system)
- content (text, markdown)

### notifications (in-app inbox, created by hooks)
- id (15 char text)
- recipient (relation -> users, required; only the recipient can read it)
- issue (relation -> issues, optional)
- comment (relation -> comments, optional)
- actor (text, display name of whoever caused it)
- actor_type (enum: user | agent | system)
- type (enum: assigned | mentioned | commented | status | priority | system)
- message (text, human-readable summary)
- read (bool)

## 5. cURL Snippets for Non-MCP Agents
### Create Task:
curl -s -X POST ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/projectbase/quick-task \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"project_key":"LOAD","title":"Add GPS tracker webhook","priority":"high","status":"todo","estimate":3}'

### Transition Status:
curl -s -X PATCH ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/collections/issues/records/<ISSUE_ID> \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"status":"done"}'

### Append Execution Log:
curl -s -X POST ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/collections/comments/records \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"issue":"<ISSUE_ID>","author":"Flomaster Agent","author_type":"agent","content":"E2E browser QA passed with zero errors."}'

### Custom Fields (per-project definitions):
curl -s -X PUT ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/projectbase/projects/<PROJECT_ID>/custom-fields \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"fields":[{"label":"Client","type":"text"},{"label":"Gate","type":"select","options":["P0","P1","P2"]}]}'

### Validate custom field values:
curl -s -X POST ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/projectbase/projects/<PROJECT_ID>/custom-fields/validate \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"values":{"client":"Acme","gate":"P1"}}'

### Set custom fields on an issue (values keyed by field key):
curl -s -X PATCH ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/collections/issues/records/<ISSUE_ID> \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"custom_fields":{"client":"Acme","gate":"P1","effort":5}}'

### Bulk actions (board/list multi-select, up to 500 ids per call):
# Update status/priority/cycle/labels/etc. on many issues at once:
curl -s -X POST ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/projectbase/issues/bulk-update \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: <USER_TOKEN>" \
  -d '{"ids":["<ISSUE_ID>","<ISSUE_ID2>"],"data":{"status":"in_progress","priority":"high"}}'
# Allowed data fields: status, priority, cycle, milestone, estimate, due_date,
# labels, order, plus per-project custom_* fields. Returns {"updated":N,"missing":N,"total":N}.
# Delete many issues at once (admin/manager role only):
curl -s -X POST ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/projectbase/issues/bulk-delete \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: <USER_TOKEN>" \
  -d '{"ids":["<ISSUE_ID>","<ISSUE_ID2>"]}'
# Returns {"deleted":N,"missing":N,"total":N}.

### Issue relationships (blocks / blocked_by / related):
# List resolved relations (outgoing + incoming) for an issue:
curl -s ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/projectbase/issues/<ISSUE_ID>/relations \
  -H "Authorization: <USER_TOKEN>"
# Add a relation (reciprocal edge is mirrored automatically):
curl -s -X POST ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/projectbase/issues/<ISSUE_ID>/relations \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: <USER_TOKEN>" \
  -d '{"issue":"<TARGET_ISSUE_ID>","type":"blocks"}'
# Remove a relation (and its mirror):
curl -s -X DELETE ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/projectbase/issues/<ISSUE_ID>/relations \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: <USER_TOKEN>" \
  -d '{"issue":"<TARGET_ISSUE_ID>","type":"blocks"}'

### In-app notifications inbox:
# List my notifications (only your own rows are visible):
curl -s ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/collections/notifications/records?sort=-created \
  -H "Authorization: <USER_TOKEN>"
# Mark one read:
curl -s -X PATCH ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/collections/notifications/records/<NOTIF_ID> \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: <USER_TOKEN>" \
  -d '{"read":true}'
# Mark all read:
curl -s -X POST ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/projectbase/notifications/read-all \
  -H "Authorization: <USER_TOKEN>"
